title: Mads Øvlisen Postdoc Fellowships 2027
about: Novo Nordisk Foundation Mads Øvlisen Postdoc Fellowships 2027, for projects conducted mainly in Denmark with a Danish host institution. The call opens 30 October 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 at 2:00pm Copenhagen time; results are announced in May 2027.
requirements: PhD or equivalent research qualification; no limit on years since the PhD
Hosting letter from a Danish university, museum or knowledge institution
Applicants living outside Denmark must show that more than 50% of the project will be conducted in Denmark
If the thesis is not approved by the deadline, a supervisor's statement must be submitted by 29 March 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD or equivalent research qualification" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Applicants living outside Denmark must show that more than 50% of the project will be conducted in Denmark" (a defined research project) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
